request_notes: Batch deletion APIs 18828, 18821 and 18807 document top-level arrays, despite naming the array in their parameter tables. The ids-file option sends a UTF-8 JSON array file as the complete application/json body through the existing raw-file encoder, without wrapping the array in an object or rounding large IDs.
Alert policy, contact and webhook mutations require confirmation and are not automatically retried; no notification delivery operation is invoked during verification.
response_notes: Default collection jobs API 20828 documents statusCode 800 but captures a successful statusCode 0 response; both published representations are accepted. License lookup retains its distinct code 0/data envelope.
Trace and topology responses retain their complete nested structures. Parallel chart series are not reduced to the first series.

notes: The three documented numeric collection switches support enabled and disabled waits scoped to the required environment code. No application readiness or successful alert delivery is inferred from object creation or monitoring samples.
